newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel Fels falls to new year low.
newsitem.headline: Keppel Fels falls to new year low.

text.p: Shares of Keppel FELS Ltd, a unit of the Keppel Corp, fell on Tuesday to a new year low of Singapore $5.55 on expectations of poor earnings, dealers said.
At 0549 GMT, the stock was changing hands at S$5.60, down 35 cents from its previous close. Volume was moderately active with 521,000 shares changing hands.

"There is talk that earnings will be worse than expected. The company apparently has faced a lot of cost over-runs," said a dealer with a local firm. "But I think there should be some support for the shares at this level."
Keppel FELS, which specialises in building offshore oil rigs, is expected to release its 1996 results next Monday.
Analysts polled in The Estimate Directory have a concensus forecast of S$54.6 million for 1996. The highest forecast was S$74.1 million while the lowest was S$47.4 million.
An analyst with a foreign broking firm said: "I don't think the company will achieve the concensus figure."
She said the company's 1996 earnings would most likely see a boost from a property sale. "But their main operations of rig building is quite weak."
Analysts said while there is a boom in the off-shore rig building market, a lot of contracts have been going to Japanese annd South Korean firms.
